+import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react-vite';
+import S3EdgeConfigurationPage from '../../../../../src/routes/_authed.appliance-services/s3-edge/-components/S3EdgeConfigurationPage';
+import { handlers as s3EdgeHandlers, s3EdgeConfigHandlers, s3EdgeStatusHandlers } from '@msw-portal/webbff/queries/s3-edge';
+
+/**
+ * S3EdgeConfigurationPage allows users to configure S3 Edge settings including buckets and access keys.
+ *
+ * Features:
+ * - Configure S3 buckets with volume mappings
+ * - Manage S3 access keys with secrets
+ * - Example configuration with syntax highlighting
+ * - JSON editor with validation
+ * - Expandable accordion for example configuration
+ * - Clipboard copy functionality for example code
+ *
+ * Note: Error handling shows UnexpectedErrorAlert when GET /configurations/s3_edge or GET /s3_edge fails.
+ * 404 errors on configuration are treated as "no config found" and don't trigger error alert.
+ */
+const meta: Meta<typeof S3EdgeConfigurationPage> = {
+  title: 'Routes/Appliance Services/S3-Edge/S3EdgeConfigurationPage',
+  component: S3EdgeConfigurationPage,
+  parameters: {
+    layout: 'fullscreen',
+    enableRouter: true,
+    route: '/_authed/appliance-services/s3-edge',
+  },
+  tags: ['autodocs'],
+} satisfies Meta<typeof S3EdgeConfigurationPage>;
+
+export default meta;
+type Story = StoryObj<typeof meta>;
+
+/**
+ * Default state with S3 Edge configuration loaded successfully.
+ * Shows configured buckets and keys with example configuration.
+ * No error alert should be displayed.
+ */
+export const Default: Story = {
+  parameters: {
+    msw: {
+      handlers: s3EdgeHandlers,
+    },
+  },
+};
+
+/**
+ * Error state when fetching S3 Edge configuration fails.
+ * Shows UnexpectedErrorAlert when GET /configurations/s3_edge returns 500 error.
+ * Tests: (isError || isStatusError) && <UnexpectedErrorAlert />
+ */
+export const ErrorInFetchConfig: Story = {
+  parameters: {
+    msw: {
+      handlers: [s3EdgeConfigHandlers.error, s3EdgeStatusHandlers.default],
+    },
+  },
+};
+
+/**
+ * Error state when fetching S3 Edge service status fails.
+ * Shows UnexpectedErrorAlert when GET /s3_edge returns 500 error.
+ * Tests: (isError || isStatusError) && <UnexpectedErrorAlert />
+ */
+export const ErrorInFetchStatus: Story = {
+  parameters: {
+    msw: {
+      handlers: [s3EdgeConfigHandlers.default, s3EdgeStatusHandlers.error],
+    },
+  },
+};
+
+/**
+ * Both fetch operations fail with 500 errors.
+ * Shows UnexpectedErrorAlert for either error condition.
+ * Tests: (isError || isStatusError) && <UnexpectedErrorAlert />
+ */
+export const ErrorInBothFetches: Story = {
+  parameters: {
+    msw: {
+      handlers: [s3EdgeConfigHandlers.error, s3EdgeStatusHandlers.error],
+    },
+  },
+};
+
+/**
+ * No configuration found (404) scenario.
+ * 404 errors are handled specially - they don't trigger UnexpectedErrorAlert.
+ * Shows empty configuration form for first-time setup instead.
+ * Tests: 404 error does NOT count as isError, so no error alert shown.
+ */
+export const NoConfigurationFound: Story = {
+  parameters: {
+    msw: {
+      handlers: [s3EdgeConfigHandlers.notFound, s3EdgeStatusHandlers.default],
+    },
+  },
+};
